research.problem_statement: Businesses in legal spend significant manual effort on: Estonia e-Residency Compliance Automator. This automation eliminates repetitive tasks, reduces errors, and accelerates turnaround.
research.target_audience: Law firms, legal departments, contract managers
research.competitor_analysis: Contract review tools exist (Kira, Luminance) but are enterprise-priced. SMB market underserved.
research.technical_feasibility: Medium — requires domain expertise, some custom integrations needed
research.roi_estimate: Reduces contract review time by 60%. Pays for itself in 1-3 weeks.
